'''Wyron Serper''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TESB" /><ref name="CCG" />

==Biography==
Serper was known as a sensor specialist, and once infiltrated the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']]. Onboard, he became familiar with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] sensor images, and, while later serving at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], was tasked with scanning the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] for approaching Imperial vessels.<ref name="CCG" />

As Echo Base's sensor and communications expert, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Serper discovered the presence of a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], prior to the Imperial [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|invasion]]. Serper's findings allowed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] time to destroy the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], though his efforts could not halt the Imperial advance.<ref name="TESB" />

During the battle, Imperial forces breached the main command center, from which Serper and his team were attempting to evacuate. A squad of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] killed the entire team after trapping them in the command center.<ref name="Insider 74" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wyron Serper first appeared as an unknown Rebel officer in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], portrayed by Candian actor [[Burnell Tucker]], credited as a portraying one of several "other officers."<ref name="TESB" /> In addition to portraying Serper, Tucker also portrayed another Rebel officer, [[Romas Navander/Legends|Romas Navander]] in the same film, and previously portrayed [[Del Goren/Legends|Del Goren]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Serper was later given a name and brief backstory in the [[November]] [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="CCG" />
